sample.summary: The change replaces `resolve()` with `absolute()` in a config file path initialization, which is a pure refactor that maintains the same behavior with a different implementation strategy - no new tests needed.

The commit modifies the Claude backend to force thinking off via environment variables and adds a test that verifies this behavior works correctly even when the agent's environment has MAX_THINKING_TOKENS set.
The commit adds a new SETTINGS constant to control extended thinking and disables hooks, with corresponding test updates that verify the settings are correctly applied through JSON parsing.
The commit adds a new MCP server module with an extensive test file (test_mcp.py) that covers the tool implementations and their interaction with the project structure.
The commit adds a new pushrange.py module that resolves commits for git pushes, with a comprehensive test file (test_pushrange.py) covering various push scenarios and edge cases.
The commit adds new git helper modules (git.py, gitcmd.py) and a comprehensive test file (test_gitcmd.py) that covers command parsing logic with multiple test cases.

This commit adds comprehensive new modules (checks.py, config.py, globs.py) and test files (test_checks.py, conftest.py) with matching test coverage for the check loading, validation, and configuration behavior.
This commit adds project scaffolding (README, .gitignore, pyproject.toml, documentation) and the __init__.py file - configuration and documentation changes that do not require tests.
